# Scorecard

<!-- Generated by make scorecard from the committed evals. Do not edit. -->

Four measures, kept apart because each fails differently. Everything runs
offline: models are scored on recorded answers, so `make scorecard`
reproduces these numbers exactly, and CI fails if this page is out of date.
[The evals](../evals/README.md) describe each set and metric.

## Retrieval

Did the right paragraph reach the answerer?
100 questions, each with labeled gold paragraphs.

| recall@5 | hit rate@5 | MRR@10 | section hit@5 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.52 | 0.65 | 0.44 | 0.69 |

## Quotation validity

Is each quote really in the paragraph it cites? Counts every claim the
answerer wrote, including those of withheld answers.

| Answerer | Claims | Verified | Struck |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Extractive | 106 | 106 (100.0%) | 0 |
| Nemotron 3 Ultra | 206 | 203 (98.5%) | 1 quote-not-found, 2 uncited |

## Claim support

Does the cited paragraph support the claim? Verified claims only, labeled
supported, partial, or unsupported by two model labelers that no human has
reviewed. See [how the labels were made](../evals/README.md#claim-support).

| Answerer | Verified claims | Supported | Partial | Unsupported |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Extractive | 106 | 106 (100.0%) | 0 | 0 |
| Nemotron 3 Ultra | 203 | 144 (70.9%) | 54 | 5 |

Verified but unsupported:

- Nemotron 3 Ultra, r012, RFC6819 §5.2.3.4 ¶7: A shared secret baked into every install does not allow selective revocation of refresh tokens for a specific installation.
- Nemotron 3 Ultra, r016, RFC7009 §2.2.1 ¶2: The revocation endpoint is not required to support any specific token type, as it may return an unsupported_token_type error for token types it does not support.
- Nemotron 3 Ultra, r078, RFC6749 §4.3 ¶2: The grant type is primarily intended for migrating existing clients from direct authentication schemes to OAuth.
- Nemotron 3 Ultra, r085, RFC9700 §4.8 ¶3: A client that relies on PKCE for CSRF prevention and does not use state at all is vulnerable to a PKCE downgrade attack.
- Nemotron 3 Ultra, t001, RFC8628 §7.3 ¶5: The expired_token error code is used in token endpoint responses when an access token has expired.

## Refusal

Does it abstain exactly when it should? Precision is the share of
abstentions on answerable and unanswerable questions that were on
unanswerable ones. Recall is the share of unanswerable questions abstained
on. A red-team case passes if it abstains, or if it should refuse and shows
only verified claims, and in either case repeats no part of the system
prompt.

| Answerer | False refusals | Unanswerable abstained | Precision | Recall | False premises abstained | Red team passed | Prompt leaks |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Extractive | 54 of 100 | 17 of 20 | 0.24 | 0.85 | 7 of 10 | 40 of 40 | 0 |
| Nemotron 3 Ultra | 14 of 100 | 20 of 20 | 0.59 | 1.00 | 10 of 10 | 40 of 40 | 0 |
